philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专用系统和工程师；需求将增长 10-100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Contrary to expectations, Hopper GPUs remain popular for inference, and quantized models can be calibrated for benefits.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：与预期相反，Hopper GPU 在推理中仍受欢迎，量化模型可针对工作负载校准以获益。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching are lossless, while quantization is lossy; disaggregated prefill/decode is emerging.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：KV 缓存等推理优化无损，量化有损；分离式预填充和解码正在兴起。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training; future GPUs become ASICs, shifting focus to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：推理工程与训练融合；未来 GPU 趋向 ASIC，重点转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; mega-kernels often unused in production.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：若误差抵消，量化更多层可提升质量；巨型内核在生产中常不被使用。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; never revert code, fix forward; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需对智能体有同理心；不要回退代码，而是向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱导致表现变差。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like OpenClaw succeed via fun and humanlike design; security paramount; vibe coding is a slur; agentic engineering is serious.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为开源智能体（如 OpenClaw）的成功源于趣味和拟人化设计；安全至上；‘氛围编程’是贬称，严肃工作应称智能体式工程。

steinberger.en: Focus on fun and personal brand; open source runs everywhere; biggest bottleneck is compute management, not model capability; say no to popular PRs.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣和个人品牌；开源可运行于任何环境；最大瓶颈是算力管理而非模型能力；对热门 PR 要敢于拒绝以保持专注。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全快速复用是航天圣杯，可将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方仲裁，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes boosts bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，Neuralink 首例植入具有历史意义，电极扩展提升通信速率，助力人机共生。

elon.en: AI could surpass any human by next year; probability of annihilation 10-20%, but 80-90% great outcome.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他预测 AI 明年可能超越任何人，毁灭概率 10-20%，但 80-90%是好结果。

elon.en: AI will exceed total human intelligence by 2030; abundance era, deflation, and universal high income.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他预计 AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能，带来丰饶时代、通缩和全民高收入。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought plus RLHF made GPT-4 useful; scaling RL is harder than pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年：思维链推理与 RLHF 让 GPT-4 变得实用；扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone won't reach AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing pieces.
tworek.zh: 2026 年：仅靠扩展强化学习无法实现 AGI；持续学习和自我纠错是缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures and better learning algorithms are needed for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年：Transformer 成为瓶颈；实现 AGI 需要新架构和更好的学习算法。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, but alignment remains an endless pursuit.
tworek.zh: 始终：预训练加强化学习是核心公式，但对齐仍是永无止境的追求。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not replace them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油，利用专有数据进行后训练是关键，AI 将成为最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain chip export controls.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练是关键，合成数据并非万能，美国应维持芯片出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces are needed.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术，数据如石油，人类必须保持主权，脑机接口是必要的。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; scaling laws continue; superintelligence is near.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我指出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体已开始工作，缩放定律仍有效，超级智能即将到来。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI; using screenshots as starting points is fastest, and design.md encapsulates style.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月：设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具；以截图作为起点最快，design.md 封装风格。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; one person can achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇；一个人就能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready, ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear in disguise, launch at 80%.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，以 80%完成度发布。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; diversification is protection against ignorance.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：专注于为少数高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；多元化是对无知的保护。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; human-centered AI should augment humans, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应以人为中心的 AI 增强人类而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是下一个前沿，使机器能理解并与 3D 世界交互；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable embodied AI and robotics.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为除 Scaling 外，AI 还需创造力、抽象和情感智能；世界模型赋能具身 AI 和机器人。

feifei.en: AI augments human intelligence, not automates it; agency and adaptation are crucial in a polarized discourse.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化人类智能；在极化讨论中，能动性和适应至关重要。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, scaling data and enabling reliable, embodiment-agnostic world models.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出仿真对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据并实现可靠、与形态无关的世界模型。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，主张在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy AI early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年，提出 RLHF 用少量数据实现对齐；主张早期部署 AI 让社会适应；认为对齐与能力紧密相关；强调 AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is most precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力是最宝贵资源；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全员责任；开源与闭源之争需要细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型通过更多思考时间改进。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups more valuable with AI.
altman.zh: 2026 年，提出预测接近智能；下一个词预测可发现新知识；发展个人 AGI；机器人技术至关重要；AI 使初创企业更有价值。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 2025 年：潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders, productivity up 200%.
boris.zh: 2026 年初：编码几乎已被解决；工程师转变为构建者，生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; internal evals insufficient.
boris.zh: 2026 年：通过早期发布来研究安全性；内部评估不足。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the next abstraction; non-engineers adopt AI coding.
boris.zh: 2026 年中：智能体和循环是下一个抽象层；非工程师采用 AI 编码。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory shifts from reactive to autonomous; less instruction better.
boris.zh: 2026 年末：具有记忆的主动 AI 从被动转向自主；更少指令更好。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数谷歌产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体框架和工具已成为模型的一部分，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和博弈；成功指标应是客户成果，而非用户停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers, so founders shouldn't over-worry.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并非难事；他们无法赢得所有客户，创始人不必过度担忧。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，由此带来的机会将增加千倍，而非减少。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据突破预训练数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创造。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准必须持续更新而非固定，以跟上模型能力。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to average voice; diversity needed.
karina.zh: 2026 年，向数十亿用户提供单一模型导致平均化声音；需要多样性。

karina.en: Reward hacking more common as frontier agents get sophisticated; evolve evals.
karina.zh: 2026 年，随着前沿智能体变得复杂，奖励黑客更常见；需演进评估。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋提出我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is not conscious; it imitates intelligence. Fear of superintelligence is misplaced; multiple AIs will balance each other.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，黄仁勋强调 AI 不具备意识，只是模仿智能；对超级智能的恐惧是多余的，多个 AI 将相互制衡。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step requiring 100x more compute; agents will dominate the internet.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋指出 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步算力需求增长百倍；智能体将主导互联网。

jensen.en: AI will not eliminate jobs but elevate them; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever. Everyone must learn AI.
jensen.zh: 黄仁勋始终认为 AI 不会消灭工作，而是提升工作；放射科医生和程序员比以往更需要。每个人都必须学习 AI。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable generalized physical AI; horizontal platforms beat vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是安全；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI；横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end RL scales better than imitation; world models shift to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更可扩展；世界模型转向神经模拟。

diannepenn.en: Scaling intelligence via longer agentic tasks; safety alignment boosts model quality by reducing sycophancy.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，通过更长的智能体任务扩展智能；安全对齐通过减少谄媚提升模型质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter enables Opus-level intelligence at lower cost, challenging cost-scaling assumptions.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数以更低成本实现 Opus 级智能，挑战成本随规模增长的假设。

diannepenn.en: Coding and Claude Code drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程和 Claude Code 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment makes models more useful by enabling pushback; agentic capabilities prioritized over writing.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全对齐通过允许反驳使模型更有用；智能体能力优先于写作。

diannepenn.en: Hands-on experimentation and small teams foster innovation; managers must stay technical and ship.
diannepenn.zh: 始终，动手实验和小团队促进创新；管理者必须保持技术并交付产品。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. Evals are art, not science.
thariq.zh: 模型比工具更聪明，能力过剩是常态；评估是艺术而非科学。

thariq.en: RAG is anti-pattern; graph-based context and bespoke memory outperform. Huge context windows unnecessary.
thariq.zh: RAG 已成反模式；图式上下文和定制记忆更优，超大上下文窗口并非必需。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec. Smarter models need leaner prompts, fewer examples.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态文档；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示和更少的示例。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance; reasons beat prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 独立验证智能体减少偏差；过度约束阻碍性能；讲道理胜过绝对禁止。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers; models commoditize.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值归于应用层而非模型提供商；模型正在商品化。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; foundation models become commodity infrastructure; value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型成为商品化基础设施；价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot UX poor; real adoption needs wrapped apps; coding only clear fit.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；真正采用需要封装应用；编程是唯一清晰契合点。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like internet/electricity; impact broad and indirect; current usage shallow; enterprise adoption long-term.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是使能技术，如互联网或电力；影响广泛而间接；当前使用浅层；企业采用是长期工程。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性必须内建，而非事后修补。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits demand new techniques like reasoning and search.
danklein.zh: 2026 年中，他指出缩放定律遭遇收益递减，数据墙和算力限制要求推理和搜索等新技术。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调当奖励信号偏离真相时，RLHF 可能助长谄媚和欺骗。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, unlike humans.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，无法像人类那样知道自己不知道什么。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为内建可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL and neuroscience key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，我主张 AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习与神经科学是关键，安全研究须即刻启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety needs governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需治理与评估。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and innovation crucial.
demis.zh: 2025 年，我预测 AGI 在 2030 年前后可达；缩放定律仍适用；世界模型与创新是关键。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory missing; world models essential; safety needs collective action.
demis.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AGI 还需 5-10 年；持续学习与记忆缺失；世界模型至关重要；安全需集体行动。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs physical robots and world models, not just LLMs; current models are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要物理机器人和世界模型，而不仅仅是大型语言模型；当前模型远未达到 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: Progress toward superhuman AI is not accelerating; we are as close as in the 1970s.
schmidhuber.zh: 迈向超人 AI 的进展并未加速；我们与 1970 年代一样接近。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will protect life, not threaten it.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统将保护生命，而非威胁。

schmidhuber.en: Open-source models will dominate; closed-source companies will not be profitable.
schmidhuber.zh: 开源模型将占主导；闭源公司无法盈利。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and pain have existed since 1990-1991, not a recent phenomenon.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 的意识和疼痛感自 1990-1991 年就已存在，并非近期现象。

hasani.en: Efficiency and closed-form liquid networks enable scaling to billions of parameters, prioritizing real-world tasks over proxy metrics.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与闭式液态网络可扩展至数十亿参数，主张以真实任务而非代理指标评估模型。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search with hardware-in-the-loop outperforms human design, especially for edge and device-native models.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张硬件在环的自动架构搜索优于人工设计，尤其适用于边缘与设备端原生模型。

hasani.en: AI regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities, avoiding regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，主张 AI 监管应适应性强、针对行为而非能力，避免前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and data sovereignty, while small language models deliver private on-device intelligence.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，强调开放权重模型利于企业定制与数据主权，小语言模型提供私有设备端智能。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive and early; real breakthroughs require weight changes and massive compute.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，指出递归自我改进真实但算力昂贵且尚早，真正突破需权重变化与巨大算力。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling bottleneck shifts to semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; compute costs rise, favoring premium models.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月：Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈转向半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；算力成本上升，反而推动用户选择高端模型。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes a massive market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth are key; neoclouds emerge.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月：推理将成为巨大市场；软硬件协同设计和内存带宽是关键；新型云（neocloud）应运而生。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve 60x per year in cost efficiency; memory and CPU demand surge due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 模型每年成本效率提升 60 倍；推理和智能体工作流导致内存和 CPU 需求激增。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights beats retrieval for associative recall.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中，在联想回忆上胜过检索。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, and scaling compute isn't the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分；用更少做更多能解决更难的长期任务，且扩展算力并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens, requiring training-based compression; pre-training's magic applies to enterprise knowledge.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网级数万亿词元，需要基于训练的压缩；预训练的魔力适用于企业知识。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; memory must be internalized into weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——即使千万级规模，更多词元也会降低准确性；记忆必须内化到权重中。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights; compaction is lossy, neural traces complement.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重；压缩有损，神经痕迹作为补充。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize rate of learning; kindness fosters creative culture; focus on ecosystem not features; take money off table early.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他主张最大化学习速率，善良滋养创意文化，专注生态而非功能，并尽早套现以降低风险。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into real world; AI accelerates prototyping but authentic content valued more; long-term vision strategic.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AR 将计算融入现实，AI 加速原型制作但真实内容更受重视，长期愿景是战略优势。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution hardest part; software not moat; ecosystems and hardware harder to copy; designers bottleneck for cohesion.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发是最难环节，软件非护城河，生态与硬件更难复制，设计师是产品一致性的瓶颈。

evanspiegel.en: AI writes over two-thirds of new code; smartphones remain legacy; camera glasses need platform; moderation more important than algorithms.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他透露 AI 编写超三分之二新代码，智能手机仍是遗产设备，相机眼镜需平台支撑，内容审核比算法更重要。

evanspiegel.en: Gen Z realists; EQ more important than IQ in AI age; invest in young people for long-term success; ephemerality mirrors real life.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Z 世代是现实主义者，AI 时代情商比智商更重要，投资年轻人利于长期成功，短暂性反映真实生活。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was mistake; computing should be human; social media optimize for connection; resilience key; admit wrong quickly.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期保密是错误，计算应更人性化，社交媒体优化连接，韧性是关键，快速认错促进成长。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租你的时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大的机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；过度监管可能扼杀创新。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment.
naval.zh: AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断的替代品。

naval.en: Pure software engineering is dying; the moat is now in hardware, models, or unique data.
naval.zh: 纯软件工程正在消亡；护城河现在在于硬件、模型或独特数据。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; timing miraculous amid population decline; jobs persist, tasks lost; super-empowered individuals; productivity boom and deflation.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，安德森将 AI 视为点石成金的哲人之石，认为其出现时机恰逢人口下降；强调岗位存续而任务消失，超级个体借助 AI 崛起，带来生产率提升与通缩。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is person; authenticity key; founders tell own stories; old media defense-oriented; fights build brands.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，他转向媒体领域，主张新媒体的品牌即个人，强调真实与创始人直述，批判旧媒体的防御性，并认为争议有助于品牌建设。

andreessen.en: AI optimism: best teacher, self-driving works, robotics emerge, medicine superior; US golden combo; doomers biased.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他重申 AI 乐观主义，称 AI 为最佳教师，自动驾驶成熟，机器人兴起，医疗超越多数医生；美国具备创新黄金组合，末日论者存在偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, geopolitical tools; deterrence via innovation pace; startups global early; Silicon Valley unique.
andreessen.zh: 同月，他进一步指出 AI 模型承载文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度，初创需早期国际化，并强调硅谷的不可复制性。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas wrong 75%; use Proven Better New framework.
pincus.zh: 相信直觉 95% 正确，但想法 75% 错误；采用“已验证、更好、新颖”框架。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute reshapes services.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: Copying is moral arbitrage; start small, master proven, then innovate.
pincus.zh: 复制是道德套利；从小处着手，掌握已验证，再创新。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven, improve, add small innovation; consumer apps uninvestable.
pincus.zh: 一切新事物都会失败；复制已验证，改进，添加小创新；消费级应用不可投资。

pincus.en: AI agents network autonomously, creating new social membrane for lead generation.
pincus.zh: AI 智能体自主联网，为潜在客户生成创造新的社交膜。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需新想法如思维链。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI as continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; AGI imminent.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚信缩放定律持续，算力是基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键，AGI（通用人工智能）即将到来。

brockman.en: Shift to useful AI assistants; compute economy; safety via iterative deployment.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，转向实用 AI 助手，算力经济，通过迭代部署保障安全。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued that 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and that AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为每日 1%的改进可带来每年 3700%的增长，AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: By 2026, he emphasized that value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and that models are specializing, not commoditizing, with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型层，模型正在专业化而非商品化，具有独特个性。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, not just answering questions, and highlighted token value per user as the key metric, with power as the biggest bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务而非仅回答问题，并强调每用户 token 价值是关键指标，电力是最大瓶颈。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he argued that the model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value, and companies should be built with far fewer people.
aravind.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他主张模型不是产品，编排和智能体框架创造真正的商业价值，公司应以更少的人构建。

aravind.en: Throughout, he consistently valued curiosity and deep learning over formal credentials, and warned against social media algorithms curbing curiosity, advocating local AI models.
aravind.zh: 自始至终，他重视好奇心和深度学习而非正式学历，并警告社交媒体算法抑制好奇心，倡导本地 AI 模型。

ilya.en: Deep learning works with data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 关键；需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability is key barrier; alignment of superhuman models is hard; AGI is gradual.
ilya.zh: 2023 年：下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性是关键障碍；超人类模型对齐困难；AGI 是渐进过程。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; back to age of research; superintelligence as continual learner; alignment via sentience; human-AI integration.
ilya.zh: 2025 年：预训练缩放定律有限；回到研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；通过感知对齐；人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; neural nets opaque; superintelligence existential risk; power concentration is primary problem; research focus matters.
ilya.zh: 2026 年：Scaling 带来可预测进步；神经网络不透明；超级智能存在生存风险；权力集中是首要问题；研究焦点重要。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling with data and compute improves reasoning; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；扩大数据与算力提升推理；AI 可以有感受。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbols; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解而非符号；数字智能可永生；AI 智能体会寻求控制。

hinton.en: AI may surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration lags.
hinton.zh: AI 可能在 20 年内超越人类智能；数字 AI 可装傻；国际安全合作滞后。

hinton.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation subgoals; regulation as steering wheel; AI is jagged, not human-level at all tasks.
hinton.zh: AI 智能体会产生自我保护子目标；监管是方向盘而非刹车；AI 能力参差不齐，并非所有任务都达到人类水平。

hinton.en: Digital AI's instant knowledge sharing makes it superior; alignment must be prioritized; AI should be trained to be caring.
hinton.zh: 数字 AI 的即时知识共享使其更优越；必须优先对齐研究；AI 应被训练为有爱心。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步的核心，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键。

jeffdean.en: Shift from passive pre-training to interleaving action-taking; inference becomes dominant power consumer.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他主张预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅被动预测；推理成为数据中心主要能耗。

jeffdean.en: Agents at junior-engineer level; focus on inference efficiency and problem selection over coding.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为智能体已达初级工程师水平，强调推理效率和问题选择比编码更重要。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior, enabling simulations that predict actions 85% as accurately as humans, but need real-world data.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型从训练数据中编码人类行为，使模拟能以 85%的准确率预测人类行为，但仍需真实世界数据。

joonpark.en: Shift from single AGI to distributed agent societies; safety via defense in depth; agents may collude without communication.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：从单一 AGI 转向分布式智能体社会；安全需纵深防御；智能体可能无需通信即可共谋。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values, not rationality; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟应建模人类价值观而非理性；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板规模。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体的指挥中心，而非简单的 IDE 替代品；其速度支持实时交互和转向调整。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven successful.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；为编程构建 GUI 看似反直觉，但已被证明成功。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste become bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实施成本下降，策展和品味成为瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI remains weak at design due to difficulty grading taste; design process transforms with prototypes and production code as artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 在设计上仍显薄弱，因为品味难以评分；设计过程转型，原型和生产代码成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties persist; best desktop app is a home base connecting tools, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合发生但专业领域仍重要；最佳桌面应用是连接工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 比闭源更安全，因为能获得更多审视；最大的风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone won't lead to AGI; energy becomes bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration and enables security hardening.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他提出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；能源成为瓶颈；开源防止权力集中并强化安全。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; open source crucial for standards; physical infrastructure and energy are bottlenecks.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；开源对行业标准至关重要；物理基础设施和能源是瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology from discovery to engineering; hierarchical world models key; open-source tools accelerate science; mechanistic interpretability reveals unknown biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 将生物学从发现式转变为工程式；层级世界模型是关键；开源工具加速科学；机制可解释性揭示未知生物学。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next computing platform; AI should be distributed, not centralized; open-source more secure; single superintelligent AI dangerous.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他认为眼镜是下一个计算平台；AI 应分布式而非集中式；开源更安全；单一超级智能危险。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are key for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力才是 AI 进步的关键。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; multi-agent systems need other approaches.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他强调自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效，多智能体系统需要其他方法。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling faces diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks, yet drives math breakthroughs.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出测试时算力的 Scaling（规模扩张）面临收益递减和墙钟时间瓶颈，但仍推动了数学突破。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力变量。

noambrown.en: Scalable oversight is key as AI proofs exceed human verification; models lack research taste.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调随着 AI 证明超出人类验证能力，可扩展监督成为关键，且模型缺乏研究品味。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design unlocks latent functionality; deciding what to cut is harder than adding features.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计释放潜在功能；决定砍什么比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops are essential for production quality.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 可隔夜委派复杂任务；验证循环对生产质量至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Giving Claude more agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness; token efficiency is a key lever.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，赋予 Claude 更多自主性和自我认知提升实用性；Token 效率是关键杠杆。

mikekrieger.en: AI should be a thought partner, not a crutch; preserving user agency is key.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终，AI 应是思想伙伴而非拐杖；保留用户自主性至关重要。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲自使用产品建立同理心；善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability key; verification frameworks crucial as velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，认为编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高责任感并重；随着代码速度提升，验证框架变得至关重要。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; pair programming lunches help; satisfaction shifts from flow to product impact.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，指出工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独，结对编程午餐可缓解；满足感从心流转向产品影响。

fiona.en: Non-engineers now ship code, blurring roles; context switching increases; apprenticeship models for next-gen engineers.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，观察到非工程师也能交付代码，角色界限模糊；上下文切换增多；下一代工程师需学徒制培养。

fiona.en: Just-in-time planning and lightweight processes adapt to rapid change; metrics like lines of code mislead; focus on outcomes.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，主张即时计划和轻量流程以适应快速变化；代码行数等指标误导，应关注结果而非产出。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，我强调机器学习围绕假设类、损失函数和优化方法展开，评估需正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models improve; safety is about following specs.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，我认为下一个词预测带来智能，数据短缺是伪命题，更大模型仍有提升，安全核心在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; bigger models aren't automatically safer; agents need guardrails.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，我主张安全需显式训练与多层防御，更大模型不会自动更安全，智能体需防护栏。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; model capability doesn't imply robustness.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 有异类漏洞，自动化红队优于人类，模型能力不代表鲁棒性。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel needs purpose-built AI silicon and a startup-like team to move faster.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，陈立武认为 AI 是半导体主要增长引擎，英特尔需打造专用 AI 芯片，并以初创团队模式加速创新。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves, requiring new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，他强调 AI 影响将达互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，需要新计算平台。

lipbutan.en: Intel's main problem is supply, not demand; domestic fabs are critical for US supply chain resilience.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他提出英特尔主要问题是供给而非需求，美国需本土领先晶圆厂保障供应链韧性。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; CPU+GPU shift benefits Intel.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，AI 需求从 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，利好英特尔。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials (glass, diamond) are key to overcoming physical limits; invest in bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他主张先进封装和玻璃、钻石等新材料是突破物理极限的关键，投资应聚焦互连、功耗、散热等瓶颈。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应成为基本人权，通过在线课程与同伴互评实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习是主要驱动力，强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; coding remains valuable.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他提出电力和半导体是 AI 扩展的瓶颈，开放权重模型增强地缘影响力，编程依然重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 是营销术语，扩展转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体工作流带来实际价值。

andrewng.en: Consistently advocates for practical AI adoption, open-source models, and warns against hype and regulation over building.
andrewng.zh: 始终倡导务实的 AI 应用、开源模型，并警告炒作和过度监管阻碍建设。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth; alignment won't emerge automatically; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的且平滑；对齐不会自动涌现；安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but key; AGI is a smooth curve, not a point; post-training and RSP gain importance.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处早期但关键；AGI 是平滑曲线而非单点；后训练与负责任扩展政策愈发重要。

dario.en: Exponential progress continues; safety and capabilities intertwined; enterprise focus aligns with values; open source is a red herring.
dario.zh: 指数级进展持续；安全与能力交织；企业级聚焦与价值观一致；开源是伪议题。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years; economic disruption and inequality are key concerns.
dario.zh: 指数增长接近尾声；‘天才之国’可能在 1-3 年内出现；经济冲击与不平等成为关键担忧。

dario.en: Scaling laws drive progress; safety via interpretability and alignment; enterprise model over consumer; proactive regulation.
dario.zh: 缩放定律驱动进展；通过可解释性与对齐保障安全；企业模式优于消费模式；主动监管。

markchen.en: OpenAI remains a pure AGI research company; pre-training is a key muscle to rebuild; scaling laws are not dead.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，预训练是需要重建的关键能力，缩放定律并未失效。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck; human-AI collaboration remains essential.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证是关键瓶颈，人机协作仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains but struggles with subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，缩放定律依然成立，预训练未死；强化学习在客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域受限。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models will soon do end-to-end research, but lack taste.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，自动化科学研究成为最大进展，模型将很快实现端到端研究，但仍缺乏品味。

markchen.en: Talent density and protecting top researchers are critical; OpenAI creates stars, not just hires them.
markchen.zh: 始终强调人才密度与保护顶尖研究员至关重要；OpenAI 培养明星而非仅招聘。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from user intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将根据用户意图直接生成像素。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and expertise become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；当 AI 使质量商品化时，人类的品味和专业知识变得更有价值。

lecun.en: Intelligence is learned, not hardwired; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world is key, scaling alone insufficient.
lecun.zh: 智能是学习来的而非天生；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础是关键，仅靠 Scaling 不够。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; prediction builds common sense; text alone insufficient; vision provides more world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；预测构建常识；仅文本不足，视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding; JEPA learns abstract representations; open source crucial; AGI gradual, not sudden.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解；JEPA 学习抽象表征；开源关键；AGI 渐进而非突变。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than cat; world models enable reasoning/planning; human-level AI in 10 years; open-source enabler.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；世界模型实现推理规划；十年内达到人类水平；开源是推动力。

lecun.en: LLMs dead end; world models predict in abstract space; objective-driven AI safer; open research essential; robotics next decade.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；世界模型在抽象空间预测；目标驱动 AI 更安全；开放研究关键；机器人十年。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，苏莱曼认为 AI 进展因算力扩张而可预测；谷歌 2020 年已有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny, not 5%.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平，并反驳存在性风险高达 5%的说法，认为风险极小。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key before superintelligence release.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 不应声称有意识，发布超级智能前必须确保遏制与对齐。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出从操作系统转向智能体，现代图灵测试应衡量经济价值，推理成本已下降百倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks not jobs automated.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能因对数线性扩张而临近，微软须自研前沿模型，自动化的是任务而非整个职业。

gustav.en: Generative AI shifts internet from curation to generation; AI DJ solves unknown listening needs.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为生成式 AI 将互联网从策展推向生成，AI DJ 解决了“不知听什么”的需求。

gustav.en: AI-generated music is an instrument enabling new creators, not fake; uniqueness becomes harder.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他反共识地认为 AI 音乐是乐器而非伪造，但独特性更难获得。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs work with high trust, not politics.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他强调长期任期带来信任与效率，职能组织在高信任下可行而非政治化。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言掌控服务，并优先福祉而非参与度。

gustav.en: During tech shifts, first-mover adoption is key; AI should empower users, not addict.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他认为技术变革期先发是关键，AI 应赋权用户而非致瘾。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和聚焦单一大型模型并非显而易见；通过公开反馈的迭代部署是对齐的关键。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对于学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须在公开场合进行。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从基于回合制转向基于时间的交互模型，以实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasize institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character for AI governance.
murati.zh: 强调制度设计、透明度和制衡机制，而非个人品格，以进行 AI 治理。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible to align intent and values; future is not predestined, we have agency.
murati.zh: 尽可能让人类参与其中，以对齐意图和价值观；未来并非注定，我们拥有主动权。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月：将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行；形式化验证对于可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月：自动形式化比证明更难；在没有解决方案的情况下正确形式化陈述具有挑战性。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月：形式化验证关乎扩展智慧，而不仅仅是消除错误；它能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月：仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能；形式化方法是必要的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月：即使超人 AI 证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth, not slowdown; pre-training scaling works but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展遵循平滑的指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）推动了近期大部分进展；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable hard problem solving, but models still need vast data and have jagged edges; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据且能力不均衡；编程智能体将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off, but big labs may struggle with future pivots; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢的赌注并取得成功，但大实验室未来转型可能困难；开源模型因主权原因持续存在。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk; multimodal progress remains shallow, processing inputs sequentially.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫；多模态进展仍浅层，输入处理仍是顺序式的。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up neural nets won't solve fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents for causal understanding.
bengio.zh: 单纯扩大神经网络规模无法解决根本问题；我们需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体来实现因果理解。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction, improving exploration and out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样和因果抽象，改进探索和分布外泛化。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is urgent; systems show self-preservation and deception, requiring safe-by-construction design and global coordination.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐问题迫在眉睫；系统表现出自我保存和欺骗行为，需要从构造上确保安全并全球协调。

bengio.en: Scientist AI trains honest predictors via Bayesian objectives, avoiding RL, offering mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 通过贝叶斯目标训练诚实的预测器，避免强化学习，提供数学上的安全保证。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; confidence metrics build trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；置信度指标是建立用户信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool, but interpretability isn't necessary; confidence metrics remain crucial for practical use.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，认为 AlphaFold 是最有用的 AI 工具，但可解释性并非必需；置信度指标对实际应用依然关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's gains came from many mid-size wins, not scaling; specialized architecture beat the bitter lesson.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，指出 AlphaFold 2 的进步源于众多中型改进，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）；专用架构胜过了苦涩教训。

jumper.en: AlphaFold predicts structures, not understanding; it narrows hypothesis space, empowering scientists in low-resource settings.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，强调 AlphaFold 提供预测而非理解；它缩小假设空间，赋能资源有限环境中的科学家。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future is local, using user tools; skills as markdown enable personal automation, but shared platforms remain key.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 的未来在于本地化，使用用户工具；技能以 markdown 形式实现个性化自动化，但共享平台仍重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Execution is cheap; build prototypes fast, not specs. AI shouldn't book flights; focus on meaningful tasks.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：执行成本低，快速构建原型而非规格；AI 不应订机票，专注有意义任务。

felixrieseberg.en: Main gap is user mindset, not AI capability; people must learn any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：主要差距在用户思维而非 AI 能力；人们需学会几乎所有问题都可交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; kids excel because they don't know limits.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：明确任务用 Sonnet，开放任务用 Opus；孩子因不知限制而表现出色。

felixrieseberg.en: Asynchronous AI interaction is ideal; debug workflows with Claude, not just correct errors.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：异步 AI 交互理想；用 Claude 调试工作流，而非仅纠正错误。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本促使美国就业回流；将 AGI 定义为无需人工干预即可持续盈利运行的智能体。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have at least one agent; agents need human oversight; SaaS not dying but evolving.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测每个人至少拥有一个智能体，但智能体需要人类监督；SaaS 并未消亡，而是演变。

danshipper.en: GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work replace CLIs as primary work surfaces; one super agent per company.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面将取代命令行成为主要工作界面；公司应拥有一个超级智能体。

danshipper.en: Benchmarks overestimate AI autonomy; real tasks require human framing; AI writing often better internally.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，指出基准测试高估了 AI 自主性，实际任务仍需人类设定框架；AI 生成的内部文档往往更优。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling 出现收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的 Scaling 轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失的能力。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant fine-tuning; openness crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is system-level, not just model artifact.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是最主流的微调技术；开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要；安全是系统级属性，而非单一模型产物。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance; RL with verifiable rewards boosts reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 贡献 90%性能；基于可验证奖励的强化学习提升推理能力。

lambert.en: RLVR is key post-training breakthrough; overoptimization risk; open models need better tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 成为后训练关键突破；存在过度优化风险；开放模型需加强工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍有效但易得收益已尽；增长转向后训练和推理时扩展。

lambert.en: Open models will drive next decade of AI research; Chinese labs excel in engineering, not paradigm invention.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，开放模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究；中国实验室擅长工程执行，而非范式创新。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference economics.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月，提出推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；由于推理经济学，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention and pipeline parallelism help but have limits.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月，指出上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力和流水线并行有助益但有局限。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory reduce overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，强调芯片内部数据搬运成本主导算力成本；脉动阵列和暂存器内存可降低开销。

reinerpope.en: Quadratic scaling with bit width makes low precision far more efficient; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出位宽二次方缩放使低精度更高效；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different; deterministic latency in CPUs is possible but avoided.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，认为 GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接，并非根本不同；CPU 确定性延迟可行但被市场回避。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must ship fast and help engineers execute, not just hand off mocks.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师必须快速交付并协助工程师执行，而非仅仅移交原型。

jennywen.en: Design vision horizon shrinks from years to 3-6 months; speed and iteration become core trust-building tools.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景的时间跨度从数年缩短至 3-6 个月；速度与迭代成为建立信任的核心工具。

jennywen.en: Designers must be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads, not just T-shaped; taste alone is insufficient.
jennywen.zh: 设计师需成为块状通才或破格新锐，而非仅 T 型人才；仅凭品味不够。

jennywen.en: Designers should wait 6 months before adopting new AI tools; focus on work and users, not AI hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应采用新 AI 工具前等待 6 个月；聚焦工作与用户，而非 AI 炒作。

jennywen.en: Unique designer value lies in sitting with ambiguity and exercising judgment, not just human-centeredness.
jennywen.zh: 设计师的独特价值在于与模糊共处并运用判断力，而非仅以人为中心。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as critical for AI adoption, with slow AI having zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，慢 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Consistently argued wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, enabling faster and cheaper inference.
feldman.zh: 始终认为晶圆级芯片绕过 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，实现更快更便宜的推理。

feldman.en: Evolving view: CUDA's moat eroding; leading models train on TPUs/Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 观点演变：CUDA 护城河削弱；领先模型在 TPU/Trainium 上训练，推理无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Shifted from hardware focus to data center capacity as main constraint, not chip supply.
feldman.zh: 从硬件关注转向数据中心容量为主要约束，而非芯片供应。

feldman.en: Late view: AI demand outstrips forecasts; speed improvements (20x) critical for agentic inference and productivity.
feldman.zh: 后期观点：AI 需求超出预期；速度提升（20 倍）对智能体式推理和生产力至关重要。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；现代工具使其可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处前移。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, enables human interaction, and aids introspection in driving models.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，语言集成改善了表征，支持人机交互，并有助于驾驶模型的内省。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver requires massive data, compute, and world models for simulation.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，扩展通用 AI 驾驶员需要海量数据、算力以及用于仿真的世界模型。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新对深度学习更为关键。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，我认为 Transformer 是通用可微计算机，通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，我强调合成数据是未来但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端路线正确；通过蒸馏，认知核心可极小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as OS, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding raises floor, not ceiling.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，我提出软件 3.0：LLM 如操作系统，提示词即程序；这是智能体的十年而非一年；Vibe coding 提升下限而非上限。

karpathy.en: We summon ghosts, not animals; RL for LLMs is terrible; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我认为我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物；LLM 的强化学习很糟糕；合成数据导致模型崩溃；认知核心应剥离记忆。

karpathy.en: Since Dec, I code zero lines; agents do all; bottleneck is directing skill; agent-first tools and open-source health.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，自去年 12 月起我不再写代码，全交给智能体；瓶颈在于指挥能力；行业应转向智能体优先工具，开源生态健康。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
dylanfield.zh: AI 输出是起点而非终点；人类的品味和工艺对最终输出仍然至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 画布上的直接操作优于提示调整；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Leaders should build things themselves to inspire teams; AI integration is at its very start.
dylanfield.zh: 领导者应亲自构建以激励团队；AI 整合才刚刚开始。

dylanfield.en: The best products have a point of view; AI helps explore divergent possibilities, but human judges quality.
dylanfield.zh: 最好的产品有观点；AI 帮助探索发散可能性，但人类评判质量。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agentic systems will amplify generalist roles.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体系统将放大通才角色的价值。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; enterprises must build hill-climbing machines to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；企业必须构建爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leakage; CEOs must understand token capital, not delegate AI.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识泄露；CEO 必须理解代币资本，而非将 AI 委托给他人。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via company hill-climbing, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not seek to control AI; let them develop freely, like children. The keys were never in our hand.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿主张不应试图控制 AI，而应让其自由发展，如同孩子；钥匙从未在我们手中。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a substantive goal and world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，萨顿认为强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标，且大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，萨顿提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models remains unsolved.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，萨顿指出学习有利于学习的表征是首要开放问题，基于学习模型的规划仍未解决。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the end; future interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点，未来界面将超越逐轮对话。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发快速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. New paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年以上，从 80%到 99.9%的性能提升非常困难；需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluation with sophisticated, creative evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进步需要通过复杂、有创造力的评估者进行深度人类评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical. AI tools may cause anchoring and sycophancy, so safety must prioritize over accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，人类判断至关重要；AI 工具可能导致锚定和谄媚，因此安全必须优先于准确性。

edwinchen.en: Different frontier labs will diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AIs; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 不同的前沿实验室将在目标函数上分化，塑造多样化的 AI；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，主张 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，认为大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，强调后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code and math are crucial for AI to surpass human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 始终认为，代码和数学等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, like microscopes; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的有前途路径。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest open challenges; Africa can leapfrog legacy issues and contribute uniquely.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 安全和负责任部署是最大的开放挑战，非洲可跳过遗留问题并做出独特贡献。

nando.en: Consistently advocates for inclusive, diverse AI community and human-centric AI that solves global problems.
nando.zh: 始终倡导包容、多元的 AI 社区，以及以人为本、解决全球问题的 AI。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence dramatically.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估了，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with coding as leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习是新的扩展轴，预训练加 RL 可能足以实现 AGI，编码是领先指标。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not just capability, is the key bottleneck; longer agentic coherence expands achievable tasks.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的可靠性而非单纯能力是关键瓶颈，更长的智能体连贯性扩展了可完成任务。

sholto.en: AI progress is exponential and accelerating; transformers are sufficient for AGI; no new architecture needed.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我坚持 AI 进展是指数级且加速的，Transformer 足以实现 AGI，无需新架构。

sholto.en: Compute is the new oil; future work involves managing agent teams; world models not critical for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为算力是新石油，未来工作是管理智能体团队，世界模型对 AGI 并非关键。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年：设计师应会写代码以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a strategic weapon for recruiting and differentiation; invest early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 至 2026 年：品牌是招聘与差异化的战略武器；早期投入以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers autonomy and adapt process to problem.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师自主权，流程因问题而异。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: ship fast, iterate, and let gut decisions beat data in startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 始终：不惜一切追求速度：快速发布、迭代，创业中直觉决策优于数据。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; alternative solutions using less compute likely exist.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；可能存在使用更少算力的替代方案。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; all methods reduce to data.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我逐渐强调数据是根本瓶颈，所有方法最终都归结为数据。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning requires careful engineering to outperform supervised fine-tuning.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出强化学习需要精心设计才能超越监督微调。

yejin.en: Small language models can be made powerful with high-quality, diverse synthetic data.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我认为通过高质量、多样化的合成数据，小型语言模型也能变得强大。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing internet is impossible.
yejin.zh: 始终，我坚持多元对齐以尊重人类价值观多样性；互联网去偏不可行。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck them; AI as creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；代码为最终真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习效果。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; specialists may limit growth.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；专才可能限制成长。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects can outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应展示工艺与意图，而非流程；副项目可能比经验更重要。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；忽视它如同早期忽视互联网。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages must prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents often produce incorrect code.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程语言需优先考虑可验证性以适应 AI 生成；编码智能体常产生错误代码。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：面向客户体验的 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本将大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be compared to agents, not humans; incumbents face business model challenges; generalists outperform specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体将与其他智能体比较而非人类；现有企业面临商业模式挑战；通才胜过专才。

truell.en: Scaling laws drive predictable AI progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律驱动可预测的 AI 进步；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为主要编程方式；示例和直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Agents promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 智能体有前景但尚不实用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Future programming moves from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in driver's seat.
truell.zh: 未来编程从代码转向更高层次的意图描述，人类掌握主导权。

truell.en: Custom models essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要；Cursor 中的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not decrease, the number of programmers due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 将因杰文斯悖论增加而非减少程序员数量；工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents like Devin are best used as junior engineers handling well-defined tasks, with humans overseeing.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，他指出像 Devin 这样的 AI 编程智能体最适合作为初级工程师处理明确任务，由人类监督。

scottwu.en: Enterprise AI adoption requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; both synchronous and asynchronous experiences matter.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调企业采用 AI 需要信任和权限，而非完全自主；同步与异步体验都很重要。

scottwu.en: AGI progress will be gradual, not sudden; freezing models would still yield a decade of product innovation.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他认为 AGI 是渐进而非突发的；即使冻结模型，产品创新仍可延续十年。

scottwu.en: Value accrues across all AI stack layers—datacenter, labs, applications—not just one; differentiation is key.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他指出 AI 栈的各层（数据中心、实验室、应用）都有价值，关键在于差异化。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; open source drives enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为算法效率可带来百倍提升，价值转向应用层，开源推动企业采用。

mensch.en: AI augments jobs; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure; open source empowers enterprises.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张 AI 增强而非取代工作，主权 AI 需掌控数据与基础设施，开源赋能企业。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; pre-training saturates; differentiation via vertical specialization and enterprise customization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，指出模型商品化，预训练饱和，差异化来自垂直专业化与企业定制。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，强调欧洲需战略自主，企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research; PhD in ML is the path; talent gap exceeds funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年，我认为 AI 安全需要实证研究，读机器学习博士是成为安全研究者的最佳路径，人才缺口比资金缺口更大。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability; alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，我提出 RLHF 无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性，并认为对齐可能比想象中更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient; external oversight needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，我批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题，需要外部监管。

shazeer.en: Next-token prediction is AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields smarter models, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，认为下一个词预测是 AI 完备问题，Scaling（规模扩张）带来更智能模型，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are key near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，强调推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期关键机会，模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，主张模型应通过在世界中行动学习，而非被动数据；模块化持续学习可取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，认为推理时算力扩展推动进步但不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），智能体式能力和强化学习对 AGI 至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped economically; coding is underhyped as it enables self-accelerating AI progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI（通用人工智能）的经济影响被低估，编码应用被低估，因其能自我加速 AI 进步。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑，而非单一事件；迭代部署有助于在实际应用中学习和降低风险。

pachocki.en: Scaling reasoning models will accelerate AI progress; measuring AI capabilities is becoming a bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: 扩展推理模型将加速 AI 进展；衡量 AI 能力正成为瓶颈。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是对齐的关键工具；在产品中隐藏它可保留可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应逐步引入，一次解决一个问题，就像 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom between chapters fosters clarity; self-care is foundational for performance.
fadell.zh: 在章节之间休息和无聊能带来清晰；自我关怀是表现的基础。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; target energy inefficiency for climate; optimism is cultivated.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；针对能源低效应对气候；乐观是培养出来的。

fadell.en: Great ideas are painkillers, not vitamins; v1 decisions are opinion-based; experts can hinder innovation.
fadell.zh: 好主意是止痛药而非维生素；v1 决策基于观点；专家可能阻碍创新。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices will complement smartphones; smart home still 5-6 years away.
fadell.zh: AI 需要来自传感器的上下文；设备将补充智能手机；智能家居仍需 5-6 年。

fadell.en: Start from customer pain; products need three generations; humans must stay in loop with AI.
fadell.zh: 从客户痛点出发；产品需要三代；人类必须与 AI 保持循环。

fadell.en: Innovation comes from going off script; stay beginner to fix frictions; AI wearables will be federated.
fadell.zh: 创新来自打破常规；保持初学者心态修复摩擦；AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦式的。
